findings.issue: בְנִדָּתָהּ (H5079, noun + her) licenses her separation/impurity, including the menstruous case the lemma still leaves open; «menstruación» narrows that state to the biological period and drops separation/impurity.
עַד הָעָרֶב is until the evening; «tarde» in current Latin American Spanish more often names the afternoon.

notes: The other clauses keep the three copulas, the participle, blood as her flow in her flesh, seven days, and the singular toucher becoming unclean.
